note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens; the Azure resource group holds one Key Vault (Standard SKU, pay per operation, a few cents for the recording window) and is deleted in teardown.
prepare: # owner signs in: az login (lab tenant, subscription Owner) and the browser profiles for labadmin (Entra admin center, Power Apps, make.powerautomate.com) and taylor.demo (Outlook on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.
az group create --name rg-mglab-power-automate-04 --location westeurope --output none
az keyvault create --name kv-mglab-pa04 --resource-group rg-mglab-power-automate-04 --location westeurope --enable-rbac-authorization true --query name --output tsv

# owner (portal, never on screen): Entra app registration 'Directory checks (lab)', Graph User.Read.All (Application) with admin consent, one client secret with 30-day expiry stored in the vault as graph-directory-checks; give the Power Platform environment read access to the vault

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 3-5): solution Directory Checks (DirectoryChecks) with the six environment variables (page size 2) and the scheduled flow 'Users without a manager'; run it once with Test > Manually

# owner (Entra, undone in teardown): managers set for alex.demo and jordan.demo (Sam Demo); riley.demo and taylor.demo without a manager; throwaway disabled user former.demo; Microsoft 365 group automation-admins (member labadmin); purchasing-team from episode 2

screens.name: app-registration
steps: Open App registrations > All applications and select 'Directory checks (lab)'
Open API permissions and show Microsoft Graph User.Read.All, type Application, status 'Granted for <tenant>'
Open Certificates & secrets and show the one client secret: description and expiry only, never the value
Pause on each page for two seconds
mask: tenant name in 'Granted for ...' and in the top bar

screens.name: env-vars
steps: Select environment DEV and open Solutions > Directory Checks
Filter the objects to Environment variables
Show the six variables: Entra authority, Entra tenant ID, Graph base URL, Graph client ID, Graph page size (current value 2) and Graph client secret
Open the secret variable and show type Secret and the Azure Key Vault source, without the vault path
mask: environment name and ID in the address bar
tenant ID and client ID values
Key Vault name and secret path
tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: run-paging
steps: Open the flow 'Users without a manager' and the manual test run
Expand 'Get all pages' (Do until) and show 4 iterations with the iteration selector at 4 of 4
Expand 'Get users page': lock icon, inputs hidden, outputs visible (keep the output panel collapsed or masked, it carries real user IDs)
mask: environment ID in the address bar
tenant ID and client ID anywhere they appear
user object IDs in Graph outputs

screens.name: report-email
steps: Open the purchasing-team mailbox (Taylor Demo is a member)
Open the mail '<N> enabled users have no manager in Entra'
Show the first line about purchase requests going to purchasing and 'Checked 4 page(s) of users'
Scroll to the Name / Mail / Department table
mask: rows for accounts that are not lab users (labadmin, the owner's own account)
real tenant domain in e-mail addresses
tenant name in the suite bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn the flow off; set Graph page size back to its default; delete the client secret or the whole app registration; delete former.demo and the automation-admins group; clear the managers set for Alex Demo and Jordan Demo; delete purchasing-team after this episode
az keyvault delete --name kv-mglab-pa04 --resource-group rg-mglab-power-automate-04 --output none
az keyvault purge --name kv-mglab-pa04 --location westeurope --output none
